final: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS order_share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_share DESC NULLS LAST) AS share_rank FROM customer_orders) SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY order_share DESC NULLS LAST, customer_id
